title: Converge to Surprise: Evolutionary Self-supervised Image Clustering
abstract: arXiv:2607.06887v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A variety of self-supervised image clustering approaches are invented in the past years. However, all dominant approaches are exploitative: The direction of parameter updates is determined by known states (observed input samples and existing parameters). We propose an explorative self-supervised learning framework that steps out of this zone. We define a surprise score that measures how unlikely the model's output representation is, assuming that all pixels are i.i.d. random noise. Maximizing the surprise score forces the deep learning model to reject the random noise null hypothesis, or equivalently, to discover non-randomness from data. Also, we propose a fundamental assumption: a surprise score cannot, in general, be fully optimized by exploitative optimization approaches. translated_title: 收敛于惊奇：进化式自监督图像聚类
translated_abstract: 过去几年中，研究者们提出了多种自监督图像聚类方法。然而，所有主流方法都是“利用型”的：参数更新的方向由已知状态（观测到的输入样本和现有参数）决定。我们提出了一个走出这一局限的“探索型”自监督学习框架。我们定义了一个“惊奇分数”，用于衡量在假设所有像素均为独立同分布随机噪声的前提下，模型输出表示的不可能性程度。最大化惊奇分数会迫使深度学习模型拒绝随机噪声这一零假设，或者等价地说，从数据中发现非随机性。此外，我们提出了一个基本假设：惊奇分数通常无法被利用型优化方法完全优化。因此，我们提出了“收敛于惊奇”方案来优化模型：即一个进化策略（ES）外循环，利用变异来最大化惊奇分数……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种探索型自监督学习框架，通过进化策略外循环最大化“惊奇分数”，迫使模型从数据中发现非随机性，从而突破传统利用型自监督图像聚类方法的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an explorative self-supervised learning framework that maximizes a "surprise score" via an evolution-strategy outer loop, forcing the model to discover non-randomness from data and overcoming the limitations of conventional exploitative self-supervised image clustering methods.
